items.title: S85-CC-Γ — Reconcile impedance-mismatch and DM/DE ratio
items.what: Test whether `Γ = 0.99970` (impedance mismatch, 0.03% leakage) and `Ω_DM / Ω_DE = 0.391` admit a joint derivation from a single underlying substrate structure. Compute `ℓ · (geometric factor)` where `ℓ = 1 − Γ`, and test whether any rational combination of A_F summand dimensions, Spin(8) orbit sizes
items.inputs: canonical `Gamma_effacement` (S74, if available; else re-derive from HP4 result); `Ω_DM`, `Ω_DE` from Planck 2018; A_F summand dimensions; Leggett winding count from S58.
